Setup

materialAluminum 7075-T6
limit503 MPa
target safety factor1.5
mass47.6 g
load4 kN 0.866,0.5,0 bearing @ hole d=8
fixturebolt holes d=6.6
part3 holes, 2 inside fillets, 0 sharp inside corners, walls about 5 mm

Assumptions

  1. Linear elastic material and small deflections (no yielding redistribution, no buckling).
  2. Aluminum 7075-T6: E 71700 MPa, Poisson 0.33, von Mises vs yield 503 MPa (ASM Aerospace Specification Metals, Aluminum 7075-T6).
  3. Loads are static and applied all at once; no impact, vibration or fatigue.
  4. Wrought metal treated as isotropic; rolled, drawn or extruded stock is close to it at yield.
  5. Bolted holes are rigidly held over the hole and a washer sized ring (twice the hole radius).
  6. Bolt loads press on the loaded half of each hole with a cosine distribution.
  7. Contact between separate parts, friction and preload are not modeled.

Notes

  • Built from bracket.py with thickness=5, arm_width=28, lug_radius=14, pin_hole=8, fillet=6.
Made with Wobbl 0.1.1. Solver CalculiX 2.23. Total time 8 s.
